subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e escrever palavras com correspondências regulares diretas entre letras e fonemas (f, v, t, d, p, b) e correspondências regulares contextuais (c e q; e e o, em posição átona em final de palavra).

components.description_pt: Ler palavras com correspondências regulares diretas para f, v, t, d, p e b
components.description_en: Read words with direct regular correspondences for f, v, t, d, p, and b
components.cc_component_description: Apply letter-sound correspondences to decode unfamiliar multisyllabic words

components.description_pt: Aplicar correspondências dependentes de contexto para c e q na leitura e escrita
components.description_en: Apply context-dependent correspondences for c and q in reading and writing
components.cc_component_description: Decode words by applying spelling-sound correspondences for consonant digraphs

components.description_pt: Escrever e e o corretamente em posição final de palavra não acentuada
components.description_en: Write e and o correctly in unstressed word-final position
components.cc_component_description: Spell grade-appropriate words correctly in writing

cc_matches.description: Know the spelling-sound correspondences for common consonant digraphs.

Use combined knowledge of all letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology (e.g., roots and affixes) to read accurately unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.
